facts.fact: Brawley 本来只计划与 Vesper 练习，Clay 因上一章争执主动要求与他在笼中对打
facts.anchor: Tonight, I was just supposed to spar with Vesper, but Clay decided he wanted his blood on my hands.

facts.fact: Brawley 虽与 Clay 交手，却承认 Clay 曾帮他免于被关起来，双方关系并非单纯仇敌
facts.anchor: Yet if it had not been for him, I would probably be locked up.

facts.fact: Brawley 把暴力视作清晰感，不是混乱；他最终打倒 Clay，但对方仍在呼吸
facts.anchor: Violence isn’t chaos to me; it’s clarity.

facts.fact: Clay 倒下后 Ares 与 Nixie 进入笼中查看他的状态，Brawley 带 Vero 离开
facts.anchor: Ares and Nixie rush inside to check on Clay.

facts.fact: Vero 整天谈 paper-cut princess，Brawley 愿意短期与女子分享伴侣，但担心她会长期留下甚至带走 Vero
facts.anchor: He has done nothing but talk about her today. I have zero issues sharing him with a woman for the night, but something tells me he may want this one around for a while.

facts.fact: 在亲密相处中 Brawley 仍检查 Vero 的状态；相关露骨过程不作为精读选句
Vero 对女孩会不会上岛存疑，Brawley 回应无论如何会帮他，但这是主观承诺并非已成事实
Brawley 私下把 Ares 看作操控众人的傀儡师；这只是 Brawley 的判断，不可当作客观真相
facts.anchor: Ares is a puppet master who has convinced everyone he is holding the strings for their own good.

facts.fact: Nixie 告诉 Brawley，她也给 Clay 安排该女子的腕带，还把 Ares 加入，以免这些人互相伤害
facts.anchor: “Oh, Clay also has a wristband for her, and I’m throwing Ares in the mix to make sure you all stay alive.”
